note: The heat of neutralisation in a calorimeter (GAME_SPEC §13, Stage 52; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 22): a foam cup with a lid (2.6 g of expanded polystyrene; its heat lost 0.12 W/K, calibrated: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md, A foam cup), a 100 mL measuring cylinder, a bottle of 1 mol/kg sodium hydroxide (0.4 mol in 400 g of water) and one of 1 mol/kg sulfuric acid (0.3 mol in 300 g). Read by instruments: 50 mL of the base and 25 mL of the acid measured in the cylinder and mixed in the cup; it warms by about 8 K, which the thermometer follows with its lag.
